SELECT
    /* ============================================================
       REQUEST
       ============================================================ */
    r.REQUEST_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(r.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_ID_HEX,
    r.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
    r.REQUEST_DATE,
    r.STATUS,
    r.CURRENT_STAGE,
    r.MAKER_ID,
    r.MAKER_ACTION,
    r.MAKER_AT,
    r.CREATED_AT,
    r.UPDATED_AT,
    r.CREATED_BY,
    r.UPDATED_BY,

    /* ============================================================
       MERCHANT
       ============================================================ */
    m.MERCHANT_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(m.MERCHANT_ID) AS MERCHANT_ID_HEX,

    m.CIF,
    m.NATIONAL_ID,
    m.OWNER_NAME_AR,
    m.COMPANY_NAME,
    m.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
    m.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,

    /* ============================================================
       CONTACT
       ============================================================ */
    m.CONTACT_NAME_AR,
    m.MOBILE_PRIMARY,
    m.ADDRESS_EN,
    m.ADDRESS_AR,

    /* ============================================================
       LOCATION
       ============================================================ */
    m.CITY,
    m.REGION,
    m.BRANCH_CODE,
    m.TEAM_LEADER,
    m.RM_ORACLE_CODE,

    /* ============================================================
       COMMERCIAL
       ============================================================ */
    m.BANK_ACCOUNT,
    m.MCC_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(m.MCC_ID) AS MCC_ID_HEX,
    m.PACKAGE_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(m.PACKAGE_ID) AS PACKAGE_ID_HEX,
    m.CONTRACT_MDR,
    m.OTHER_POS_COMMISSION

FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST r

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT m
       ON m.REQUEST_ID = r.REQUEST_ID
      AND m.IS_DELETED = 0

WHERE r.REQUEST_ID =
      HEXTORAW(
          REPLACE(
              '{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.requestId }}',
              '-',
              ''
          )
      )
  AND r.IS_DELETED = 0
